title: Leaks!
text:
Leaks!. Had to return the first soap dispenser, because it leaked from the bottom. Amazon replaced it. The second soap dispenser also leaked.

They look nice, but not worth the trouble.

product_metadata.title: Progressive International Acrylic Soap Dispenser, One Size, Clear
features: Serving multiple purposes, the dispenser can also be used for body lotions as well as soap
Durably constructed of acrylic, santoprene, and stainless steel
Features a comfortable santoprene pump knob and a rubber, non-skid, non-marring base
Extra-long spout allows dispenser to easily apply contents to brushes and sponges or pump directly into sink
Comes unfilled and will hold up to 12-1/2 ounces; safe to clean in the dishwasher between uses
description: The extra long spout allows this dispenser to easily apply soap to brushes and sponges and features a comfortable Santoprene pump knob. The Soap Dispenser is environmental-friendly with being reusable and refillable and can hold soap, lotion or essential oils. The durable construction with rubber non-skid and non-marring base helps keep the dispenser stable while in use during wash sessions. Each dispenser pump holds up to 12.5 ounces(375 ml)
